newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: GOV'T TO RETAIN STAKE IN SHIPYARD.
newsitem.headline: GOV'T TO RETAIN STAKE IN SHIPYARD.

text.p: Lithuania's Minister for European Affairs, Laima Andrikiene, said on Wednesday that the government planned to retain its 32.5 percent stake in the Baltic Shipyard, which plans to launch a new share issue.
"The government will keep its stake of 32.5 percent in the Baltic Shipyard...we intend to buy into the next share issue," Andrikiene said at a news conference.
She added that the government would then sell its shares on the Vilnius bourse.
Denmark's Odense Shipyard last week bought a 43 percent stake in the company in a block trade on the Lithuanian stock exchange.
The company's shareholders' meeting last week decided to double its share capital, which is currently 34.59 million litas.
